Create a premium HAVENLINE game-resource 360-degree concept turnaround sheet, matching the supplied Havenline art boards precisely in visual language: polished stylized 3D, chunky rounded forms, broad sculpted details, warm caramel wood, restrained cool-metal highlights, readable game silhouettes, handcrafted inviting winter-survival aesthetic. The reference images are STYLE references, not edit targets. Do not copy their buildings, layout, UI or tiny text.
Landscape high-resolution sheet, ideally 3072x2048. Uniform dark navy studio background. Elegant clear small heading at top and eight equally sized view panels arranged exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows. Same SINGLE asset rotated in place about the vertical axis, same physical geometry and color/material pattern in EVERY panel. Camera elevation 15 degrees above horizontal, orthographic-like product rendering. Consistent subject scale, fixed soft neutral studio light, generous margins, fully visible objects. Exact clockwise yaw order: top row FRONT 0°, FRONT RIGHT 45°, RIGHT 90°, REAR RIGHT 135°; bottom row REAR 180°, REAR LEFT 225°, LEFT 270°, FRONT LEFT 315°. Front and rear must be genuinely opposite surfaces; right and left are true narrow end/profile views, not repeated three-quarter views. Make stable distinctive landmarks and physically coherent occlusions. Each view gets only its exact readable name below. No perspective diagram arrows, no environment, no ground tile, no props, no anatomy, no hands, no logos/watermarks. Small footer reads "360° CONCEPT TURNAROUND".
CRUCIAL PROJECTION RULE: front-right45 and rear-left225 show the same sloping long-axis silhouette with opposite faces; rear-right135 and front-left315 show the opposite sloping silhouette. Never repeat135 under the225 label. Top row views clockwise0,45,90,135; bottom row180,225,270,315. Every45 degree step must reveal distinct faces and occlusion, not simply relabel the preceding cardinal view. The resources should remain simple stackable pickup units; no extra crates/trays except a resource itself requiring a container. Raw and cooked states must be visually different. No photographic pores, blood, organs, splatter or anatomical carcasses.

specs.title: PROCESSED MEAT
specs.body: The asset is ONE finished meat portion directly matching the rounded rectangular red/brown meat blocks visible in supplied cooker output-tray reference. Broad thick block with softened corners, proportions1.25 long X x0.85 deep x0.65 high. Deep warm meat-red front and side walls with broad cream fat marbling; a thick pale cream FAT CAP on top, with a simple orange-brown cooked rim around its upper edge. This is meat itself, NOT a crate, parcel, loaf, wrapped lunch or package. No straps, ribbon, plastic, tray, plate, fork, machine or steam. Top fat cap slopes very slightly down toward its LEFT end. A single broad diagonal cream streak is on FRONT face; REAR is more uniform burgundy-brown with a small cream patch at right edge. Keep these landmarks fixed as the portion turns. FRONT/REAR show broad faces, RIGHT/LEFT narrower ends. At225 the short end must be imageRIGHT and broad rear imageLEFT. Style from Havenline boards, single stackable in-game output unit. The source crop establishes visible appearance only; unseen sides are coherent proposed completion.

specs.title: COOKED FISH
specs.body: ONE golden-orange COOKED WHOLE FISH resource pickup, based on cooked fish-shaped output on the supplied reference A conveyor. Compact plump cooked body, warm roasted amber-orange surface, three broad dark toasted diagonal sear bands across body, pale golden belly, small simply modeled fins, intact modest forked tail, little closed-mouth head and one subtle dark eye on each side. It must read unmistakably cooked, different from raw blue-silver fish. Length1.5, height0.6, depth0.4. Stylized broad sculpting, no photographic scales, no steam, no plate, no skewers, no packaging. Rigid horizontal asset: FRONT0 side-on with HEAD imageLEFT and TAIL imageRIGHT;45 looks tailward with tail NEAR imageRIGHT and head recedingLEFT; RIGHT90 is exact TAIL-end view;135 tail NEAR imageLEFT and head farRIGHT; REAR180 opposite side headRIGHT/tailLEFT;225 HEAD NEAR imageRIGHT and tail farLEFT; LEFT270 exact head-on;315 HEAD NEAR imageLEFT and tail farRIGHT. Keep same fins, sear marks and fat belly through all views. No duplicate side view relabeled45 or225.

specs.title: TIMBER PLANKS
specs.body: ONE tidy pickup bundle of THREE thick sawn timber planks, matching Havenline caramel wood and the atlas PLANK resource. Each plank a long rectangular beamlike board with planar faces, gently beveled corners, broad sculpted curved grain and clear short rectangular cut ends, substantially different from round logs. Three boards stacked vertically, top board slightly shorter by10%, warm honey cut ends and medium chestnut broad side faces. Proportions2.0 length X x0.7 depth x0.55 total height. One flat tan band around midpoint, flush with boards, no knot, no metal bands, no base/pallet, no snow or tools. A broad single wood knot centered near front-left of TOP plank broad side. FRONT0 long side; RIGHT90 three rectangular ends stacked; REAR180 other long faces, knot hidden; LEFT270 opposite ends. At45 expose rectangular ends imageRIGHT;135 ends imageLEFT with rear faces;225 ends imageRIGHT with opposite rear faces;315 ends imageLEFT with front faces. Keep same3 boards, lengths and band position.
